title: Isabella Bank Partners with Hemlock Public School District to Create a New Community Gathering Space
summary: A new community gathering space is enhancing the experience for students, families, alumni, and fans attending athletic and community events at Wallace Field in Hemlock.
body_markdown:
A new community gathering space is enhancing the experience for students, families, alumni, and fans attending athletic and community events at Wallace Field in Hemlock.


At the start of the 2026 high school football season, Isabella Bank partnered with Hemlock Public School District as the official sponsor of the Isabella Bank Fieldside Lounge, a new semi-private gathering space located near Wallace Field and the Patrick Wolgast Fieldhouse.


The Isabella Bank Fieldside Lounge features a serving bar with seating for a dozen or more guests, additional gathering space, a large sunscreen, Edison-style lighting, and the district's new “Swag Shed.” The space will welcome different groups for staff and family gatherings, community events, alumni activities, special celebrations, and other district functions throughout the year.


“Isabella Bank has been a tremendous community partner, and we are incredibly grateful for their willingness to invest in something that is really about people,” Superintendent Dr. Don Killingbeck said. “The physical space is great, but what excites me most is thinking about the conversations, celebrations, relationships, and memories that will happen there over the years.”


That vision aligns closely with Isabella Bank’s long-standing commitment to investing in the communities it serves.


“As a community bank, our commitment goes beyond providing financial services. It means investing in places and opportunities that help communities thrive,” said Jerome E. Schwind, President and CEO of Isabella Bank Corporation and CEO of Isabella Bank. “The Isabella Bank Fieldside Lounge will give people a new way to connect, celebrate, and enjoy the traditions that make Wallace Field such a special gathering place. We are honored to support Hemlock Public School District and the experiences this space will create for generations to come.”


Board of Education President Matt Wesener said the partnership reflects the district's broader commitment to creating facilities that serve students while also strengthening connections throughout the community.


“Some of the best investments we can make are in spaces that bring people together,” Wesener said. “The Isabella Bank Fieldside Lounge gives us another opportunity to welcome families, recognize staff, connect with alumni and community partners, and celebrate the people who make Hemlock special. We are grateful to Isabella Bank for seeing the potential in this project and helping us bring it to life.”


**About Isabella Bank**


Isabella Bank Corporation (NASDAQ: ISBA) is the parent holding company of Isabella Bank, a state-chartered community bank headquartered in Mt. Pleasant, Michigan. Isabella Bank was established in 1903 and has been committed to serving its customers' and communities' local banking needs for over 120 years. The Bank offers personal and commercial lending and deposit products, as well as investment, trust, and estate planning services. The Bank has 33 locations throughout nine Michigan counties: Bay, Clare, Gratiot, Isabella, Kent, Mecosta, Midland, Montcalm and Saginaw. For more information about Isabella Bank Corporation, visit the Investor Relations link at[www.isabellabank.com](https://www.isabellabank.com/home) .
